The fix is to parse both formats in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH p AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S')
         ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts_parsed AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM p;"}}
